messages.text: Done-when for this unit passes locally (pnpm typecheck exit 0; ScoreTrend.tsx gone; no importer in src/tests/shared/server). Integration must run: pnpm build; pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/home.spec.ts tests/e2e/settings.spec.ts tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts. Then in the Play dev-link: mark an overdue action as Feita, change the reevaluation interval, switch modes; both homes' numbers must change. Owner home ids: home-reeval, home-reeval-count, home-reeval-interval, home-reeval-timeline, home-reeval-reminder, home-trava, home-widgets, home-actions-widget.

Tour v2 differs from tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts: the '?' no longer navigates to #/inicio. Step 1 opens /empresa/:focusId/relatorios, step 2 /configuracoes, step 3 /empresa/:id/acoes, step 4 /empresa/:id/diario, step 5 stays (anchor modo). Same 5 steps in both modes. Seen state is tourSeenVersion >= 2; closing also sets tourSeen[mode]=true. Auto-open waits for home-owner.

Owner widget counts come from GET /api/home and are re-read on each opening (HomePage reloads on mount). Changing a status in 'Suas 3 ações' updates that row at once, but 'Ações do plano' counts change on the next opening, as AC-ra-36 states.

Route wiring: who adds the empresa/:companyId 'relatorios' child route in src/App.tsx? The owner home and tour depend on it. src/App.tsx is shared with phase-4-frontend-diary, so it was not touched by this unit.
